turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Why was Owen's mark changed to a zero before anyone called me?
I'll stand. Twenty minutes, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
I didn't call you, Hale. Nobody called me, and I found out from a gradebook. Who decided on the zero?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
Don't manage me, Hale. The zero doesn't stand, and I'm not moving on. What do you have besides the checker?
